articles.summary: Customer Base for Carbon Capture, Fuel Cell, and Electrolysis Applications is Expanding MILTON, NY, November X, 2021 – Sono-Tek Corporation (NASDAQ: SOTK), the leading developer and manufacturer of ultrasonic coating systems, today announced the expansion of its New York laboratory facilities for catalyst coated membranes. The expansion is driven by a strong increase in demand…
articles.title: Sono-Tek Announces Laboratory Expansion for Catalyst Coated Membranes to Meet Demand
